technical-summary: release-install installs a bc-radiance release that has no committed release-record entry from the release's own CI assets (radiance-<plan>.tar.gz, .sha256, .receipt.json) after verifying: one archive whose sha256 matches its .sha256 and the receipt; receipt release_tag == requested tag; runtime_key engine/config trees equal the tag's git trees; ROCm equals the host SDK; every extracted file's digest/size equals bundle.json (restore); a reused bundle's bundle.json may name another tag only via reused_from with equal trees. A record entry still wins. Receipt gains source record|ci. latest picks the newest tag with a record entry or a CI bundle.
user-summary-candidate: Releases built by CI can be installed with release-install; the bundle is verified against the release tag and the host's ROCm before it is used.
